run_bleu_corpus_scoring: run BLEU scoring of generated translations against reference translations using fairseq
run_bleu_sacrebleu_scoring: run BLEU scoring using sacrebleu for standardized corpus-level evaluation
run_bleu_sentence_scoring: run sentence-level BLEU scoring with smoothing for per-sentence evaluation
run_bleu_case_insensitive: run case-insensitive BLEU scoring by lowercasing system and reference outputs
run_bleu_custom_ngram_order: run BLEU scoring considering n-grams up to a custom order N
